clues: Most of this city sits on a big island, and a small part sits on a small island near it. A strait parts it from a city in Sweden.
A warm stream in the sea flows past this far north city and makes it warmer than its place on the map would suggest. The lift is about five degrees in all.
In about 1416, a king named Eric moved his seat to the castle in this town. From then on, this town was the capital of the whole land.
A small statue shows the Little Mermaid from a famed tale of the sea. She counts as one of the best known sights in this whole city.
The government of Denmark runs from this city. It is the hub for the rule, trade, and arts of the whole land.
